text: Geography is a comprehensive discipline that studies the interaction between natural and human elements on the Earth's surface and their spatial distribution laws, and it has the attributes of both natural science and social science. The core lies in revealing the formation mechanism and evolution law of the geographical environment (such as climate, landform, population and city) through spatial analysis, regional comparison and dynamic modeling. Modern geography integrates technologies such as remote sensing (RS), Geographic Information System (GIS), and Global Positioning System (GPS), forming a trinity disciplinary system of "theory - technology - application", and cultivating compound talents with spatial thinking, data processing, and cross-disciplinary problem-solving abilities.
